notes.title: New Update to Misao - 2024 HD Remaster Coming Midnight August 15, 2024!
notes.content:
Misao: Definitive Edition was released back in October 2017, and now it's about to be updated to Misao - 2024 HD Remaster at midnight on August 15, 2024!

Misao - 2024 HD Remaster doesn't only add HD graphics and update the overall presentation, but also adds new features that make exploring stages all the more enjoyable, giving the game a new playfeel.

No matter if you've already witnessed all the horrors of Misao, or are stepping into the Other World for the first time, we hope you enjoy the newly reborn Misao.

The original Misao: Definitive Edition can still be played after the update. You may choose which version to play upon launch.

After the HD Remaster update, the price of the game will be increased to $9.99. However, the game is currently on sale for 20% off its original price until 9:59 AM August 14, so please grab this chance to buy the game before the price increase!
